Laurey 39320 3 Inch Foundry Pull in Matte Black

text.description_html:
Laurey 39320, Swirl Foundry Matte Black Cabinet Pull

The Foundry Matte Black Cabinet Pull is a rustic kitchen cabinet handle that is well suited to traditional Americana homes. The swirl design adds a point of interest to this 3 inch cabinet pull that also serves to highlight the beauty of the Matte Black finish. The Foundry Matte Black Cabinet Pull comes packaged with the mounting hardware.

This cabinet pull is part of the Laurey Foundry Collection.

Specifications and Features of the Laurey 39320 3 Inch Foundry Pull in Matte Black:

  • Material: Zinc
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-3/4"
  • Width: 3/4"
  • Projection: 1-1/8"
  • Packaged with 1" long #8-32 screws and 1-1/2" long #8-32 screws.
